parameters.name: DomainName
parameters.description:
The streaming domain. You can specify a single domain name or multiple domain names. Separate multiple domain names with commas (,). If this parameter is left empty, the merged data of all live streaming domains is returned by default.
> - When you specify DomainName, make sure that the specified domain names are live streaming domains and that you have the required permissions to operate on the specified domain names.

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end time. The end time must be later than the start time. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format in UTC.

parameters.name: Interval
parameters.description:
The time granularity for querying data. Unit: seconds. Valid values:
- **300** (default).
- **3600**.
- **86400**.

> If you do not set this parameter or set it to an unsupported value, the default value **300** seconds is used.

parameters.name: IspNameEn
parameters.description: The name of the Internet service provider (ISP) in English. You can call the [DescribeCdnRegionAndIsp](~~91077~~) operation to obtain the ISP name. If you do not set this parameter, data of all ISPs is returned.

parameters.name: LocationNameEn
parameters.description: The name of the region in English. You can call the [DescribeCdnRegionAndIsp](~~91077~~) operation to obtain the region name. If you do not set this parameter, data of all regions is returned.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The start time. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format in UTC. >You can query data from the past **90** days.
